title: fix(organizations): the walled Default Organization's seed resolves its bound owner
body:
Fixes #34425
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:隔离(walled)部署首次启动时,系统自动创建的默认组织(Default Organization)的示例数据(seed)回放,从"组织行写入时"推迟到"平台所有者成为该组织成员之后",示例数据里指向所有者的人员字段(指派人、审核人等)现在能正确填上。
- 为什么改:原来回放早于所有者的成员行写入,默认组织里一个成员都没有,示例数据中所有指向所有者的人员字段都存成空值;只有负责人(owner_id)靠后续的归属交接被补上,其它人员字段一直为空。
- 风险与回滚:只改了 `@objectstack/organizations` 一个中间件的触发时机,复用 #34038 已上线的"等待第一个成员再回放"机制;非隔离部署、用户新建组织、导入与迁移等路径不变,每个组织仍只回放一次;启动流程没能绑定所有者时,仍会在启动调用结束时照旧回放。回滚即还原这一个 PR。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/organizations/src/organizations-plugin.ts`(Middleware B 的默认组织等待分支与 runEnsure 的兜底回放)、`default-organization-seed-owner.wall.test.ts`(真实隔离启动的复现测试)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/organizations exec vitest run src/default-organization-seed-owner.wall.test.ts`,预期 3 个用例全绿;在 main 上第二个用例是红的(所有者的指派人、审核人字段为空)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**Landing point: `packages/plugins/organizations/src/organizations-plugin.ts` only.** On a walled posture the default-organization bootstrap is wired by this package alone (`AuthPlugin` skips its own bootstrap under a wall), and the replay trigger is this package's Middleware B. `plugin-auth`'s `ensure-default-organization.ts` is unchanged: it still writes the organization, then the owner's member row, then runs the seed-ownership handoff. Both `ensure-default-organization.ts` files named in the claim's file surface are untouched.

The order on main, measured on a walled `bootStack`: the bootstrap inserts the `default` organization as SYSTEM with no person behind it, Middleware B replays the seed inside that insert, every person reference in the seed is refused as "not a member of organization ORG", and only then does the owner's `sys_member` row land. The seed-ownership handoff re-owns NULL `owner_id` rows afterwards, so `owner_id` reads right and every other person column (a `Field.user()` column, a `Field.lookup('sys_user')` column) stays NULL.

The change reuses the mechanism #34038 added for the organization-create path (the `awaitingFirstMember` wait, released by the organization's first `sys_member` insert, one replay per organization). It adds a second way in, and no second mechanism:

- While this plugin's default-organization bootstrap is running (a counter, because the owner bind re-enters the bootstrap from inside the deciding call), a SYSTEM `sys_organization` insert with slug `default` and no `userId` no longer replays on the insert. It waits for the organization's first member row and replays inside it, after the row is stored. The replay names that member (the bound owner) as the locale user, as the founder is named on the create path.
- When the bootstrap binds nobody (the owner bind was decided earlier and only the organization was recreated, or the member write failed), the last bootstrap call to finish replays the still-waiting organization at once, with no person. That is the order it had before, delayed only to the end of the bootstrap call.
- Every other organization insert is unchanged: an attributed create waits as before, and any other SYSTEM or `userId` insert replays on the insert.

**No signal is borrowed from attribution.** Stamping `attributedUserId` on the bootstrap's organization insert would also have made Middleware B wait, but `attributedUserId` is the audit attribution channel (`sys_audit_log.user_id`), and nobody acted to create the Default Organization. The bootstrap-scoped wait keeps the audit row as it is.

## Tests

- New `packages/plugins/organizations/src/default-organization-seed-owner.wall.test.ts`: `bootStack` (`@objectstack/verify`) with the real `AuthPlugin`, `SecurityPlugin`, `AppPlugin` replayer and this package's `OrganizationsPlugin`. The app's seed names the harness's dev admin (the declared platform owner on a walled boot) in a `user` field, a `lookup` to `sys_user` and `owner_id`.
  - premise: the wall is up, and the Default Organization's only member is the owner, role `owner`;
  - the Default Organization was seeded once, and all three references store the owner's user id;
  - control, un-walled boot of the same app: the wall is down, the row is seeded once, and it reads exactly as on main.
- `organizations-plugin.test.ts`, new top-level describe on an engine double whose inserts run the plugin's middlewares, driven by the owner's verified `sys_user` insert (the walled bootstrap trigger):
  - the `default` organization replays once, inside the owner's member write, naming the owner, and the member row is stored when the replay reads membership;
  - control: with the member write refused, the organization still replays once, with no person.

## Acceptance notes

- **The card's un-walled baseline does not resolve these references either, for another reason.** Measured on the un-walled control boot: the boot seed loads before the dev admin's `sys_user` row exists, so `assignee` and `reviewer` land NULL with "no such sys_user row exists", and only the first-admin handoff writes `owner_id`. The card reads "exactly as on an un-walled boot"; on this fixture the un-walled boot is not a resolving baseline. The walled replay runs after the owner exists and is the person being bound, so after this change it resolves them. The un-walled reading is the same class of gap reached through another entry point (only `owner_id` is repaired), and this PR does not fix it: it is carried by #34458. The control pins the un-walled reading as it stands on main, so a change to the un-walled path shows up there; #34458's Done-when flips that control (`control: the same seed on an un-walled boot reads as it did before the fix`) to the admin id.
- **Residual, not changed here:** if the bootstrap call throws after inserting the organization and before its member write, the waiting entry stays until a later member write releases it (the next bootstrap trigger binds the owner) or the abandoned-create warning drops it. `ensureDefaultOrganization` catches its own write failures, so no such throw is known.
- No public contract moves: no spec, export, hook signature, error code or route changes.
